meta.name: adversarial-audit
meta.description: Adversarial whole-repo audits in three goal-spec modes — hunt defects, drift, and dead ends rather than validate. Triggers "adversarial audit", "fable audit", "audit the codebase", "expectation gaps" (codebase mode - correctness, incoherences, affordance mismatches); "audit the docs", "docs audit", "documentation audit", "doc drift" (docs mode - accuracy vs code, inverted pyramid, doc sizing, diagram backlog); "process audit", "audit the workflows", "walk the journeys", "end-to-end audit" (process mode - empirical journey walking, state-machine map, dead ends, re-run semantics). Sibling to /nuclear-review (maintainability + code-judo deletion) - this skill audits whether the system does what it promises, not whether it should exist.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对抗性审计代码仓库，找出缺陷、漂移和死胡同
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要对整个仓库进行深度审查，找出隐含问题
copy.tagline_en: Audit code repositories adversarially to uncover defects, drifts, and dead ends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deeply audit a codebase for hidden problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以对抗性方式审计整个仓库，找出缺陷、文档漂移和流程死胡同，而不是验证代码。它按三模式运行：代码库（找正确性与一致性漏洞）、文档（核对文档与代码一致性）、流程（检查端到端工作流的完整性）。报告含稳定 ID 的发现，并先自我反驳再输出。
howto.when: 当你说出“adversarial audit”、“audit the codebase”、“audit the docs”、“process audit”等触发词，或指定模式时触发。通常在版本切割、发布前、功能爆发后使用。

say.text: 对这个代码库做一次对抗性审计，找逻辑错误和不一致。
say.note: 触发 codebase 模式，输出缺陷报告。

say.text: 检查文档与代码是否一致，列出漂移之处。
say.note: 触发 docs 模式，核对文档准确性。

say.text: 走一遍整个工作流，看有没有死胡同。
say.note: 触发 process 模式，模拟端到端流程。

howto.what_en: Claude performs adversarial whole-repo audits in three modes — codebase (defects/incoherences), docs (drift/inaccuracy), and process (dead ends/missing transitions). It reads everything, tries to disprove findings before reporting, and outputs a structured report with stable IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "adversarial audit", "audit the codebase", "audit the docs", "process audit", or when specifying a mode. Typically used before releases, after feature bursts, or at version cuts.

say_en.text: Run an adversarial audit on this codebase for correctness issues.
Check docs against code and list any drift.
Walk through the entire workflow and find dead ends.
